title: Unit compatibility of the constructed single-open comparison
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an open of $X$, and let the derived module categories on $X$ and $U$ exist [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $I$ be a K-injective cochain complex of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Write $J_U$ and $\eta_U$ for the fixed complex and unit of [def-pc-kinjective-mayer-vietoris-data], and $L_U$ for exact open restriction [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. Let $a_U:D(L_U)\dashv Rj_{U*}$ be any supplied adjunction with the direct image of [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. For the constructed comparison $c_U$ of [def-pc-open-image-complex-comparison-iso], $c_U\circ Q(\eta_U)=\operatorname{unit}(a_U)_{Q(I)}$.

source.place: Tag 08BV (lemma-exact-sequence-j-star), first proof paragraph and displayed restriction/direct-image sequence; Tag 08BS (lemma-restrict-K-injective-to-open)

proof.text: Apply Adjunction.derivedη_fac_app to the homotopy adjunction of the fixed underived adjunction. Its unit is the quotient of the termwise unit by mapHomotopyCategory_unit_app_quotient. Expand mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh_hom_app and rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso. Naturality of quotientCompQhIso changes Q of the unit to Qh of its quotient. The derived-unit factorization then cancels the restriction comparison and quotient comparisons; naturality of the derived unit gives its value at QI.
Postcompose with the constructed rightAdjointUniq component and apply Mathlib Adjunction.unit_rightAdjointUniq_hom_app. This is the supplied unit.

theorem schemeOpenModuleImageComplexComparison_unit (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective]
    (adj : (schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage U.ι) :
    DerivedCategory.Q.map (schemeOpenModuleImageComplexUnit X U I) ≫
        (schemeOpenModuleImageComplexComparison X U I adj).hom =
      adj.unit.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)
